response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during the trip. Clause A4.1 covers 'primerané a nevyhnutné náklady na ambulantné ošetrenie... ak boli vynaložené v dôsledku akútneho ochorenia alebo úrazu počas cesty.' The evidence confirms the injury occurred during the trip and required treatment, which is covered under this clause. There is no indication of a pre-existing condition (A5.1) or planned treatment (A5.2)."}
